sources.summary:
The GitHub Code Quality upload-code-coverage action now checks that your coverage report is in Cobertura XML format. If it isn’t in a supported format, the upload step fails and the…
The GitHub Code Quality upload-code-coverage action now checks that your coverage report is in Cobertura XML format. If it isn’t in a supported format, the upload step fails and the Actions log shows this error:
This file is not a Cobertura XML report. Upload a Cobertura XML report.
Previously, these uploads appeare
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Code Quality 的 upload-code-coverage action 现在校验报告须为 Cobertura XML，格式不符会让上传失败并在 Actions 日志报错，此前却看似成功但 PR 无覆盖率。

en.reason: GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action now rejects non-Cobertura XML reports, failing the upload with “This file is not a Cobertura XML report” in the Actions log instead of appearing successful while leaving pull requests without coverage.

en.reason: Hugging Face's hub hosts roughly 3,500 eval leaderboards and its eval datasets grew about 16x in a year to some 17,000, and this guide covers how to build and maintain an agentic evaluation, from defining expert tasks to scoring.

stories.title: Z.ai 紧随 OpenAI 之后，以全新 750B 旗舰模型进军循环 Transformer 领域 / Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model

sources.title_original: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
sources.summary:
Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters. Benchmark scores are only available for a smaller 30B test model so far, and Z.ai is positioning GLM-5.4 as the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models.

sources.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 解开了一道其他 AI 都攻克不了的数学定理，还自创了一套证明策略 / GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
sources.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 解开了一道其他 AI 都攻克不了的数学定理，还自创了一套证明策略
sources.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
sources.title_original: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
sources.summary:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved.

sources.title_original: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
sources.summary:
US intelligence agencies tracked contacts between Alice Huang and China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, the New York Times reports. The surveillance ran parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Federal investigators are now looking into whether a network of companies in Southeast Asia was used to smuggle AI chips into China in violation of US export controls. Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before the US House of Representatives on December 1.
US intell

en.reason: US intelligence tracked Alice Huang's contacts with China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, as investigators examine whether Southeast Asian firms smuggled AI chips to China.

en.title:
The weekend’s biggest news wasn’t a US stock market crash—it was AI claiming to prove the Riemann Hypothesis

This weekend, what truly shook the world was not the sharp selloff in US stocks but news from the math world: on November 20, Levent Alpöge, a 34-year-old mathematician at Anthropic, posted a statement on his personal website saying he had worked with the company’s large model Claude to find a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, which has puzzled mathematicians for 167 years, and that the method could be extended to the stronger Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
en.reason: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge's November 20 announcement that he and Claude found a proof of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and say the method extends to the generalized Riemann hypothesis, landed the day after Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO, a timing he called "terrible.

stories.title: 构建主权 AI 技术栈：开放权重、前沿模型与企业控制平面

sources.title: 构建主权 AI 技术栈：开放权重、前沿模型与企业控制平面
sources.title_zh: 构建主权 AI 技术栈：开放权重、前沿模型与企业控制平面
sources.title_original: 构建主权 AI 技术栈：开放权重、前沿模型与企业控制平面
sources.summary:
构建主权 AI 技术栈：开放权重、前沿模型与企业控制平面随着前沿大模型的能力不断提升，企业正面临一个关乎未来的架构性问题：究竟应该将多少智能能力置于自身无法掌控的系统之中？

每一次与 AI 应用的交互，都可能产生具有价值的上下文信息，包括工作流执行轨迹、专家修正意见、评估结果、客户洞察，以及反映企业业务运作方式的各类信号。然而，如果企业未能有意识地捕获并治理这些持续积累的知识，就可能面临一种风险：AI 系统不断消耗企业的专有知识，却无法将其转化为企业自身可长期积累和利用的资产。

企业必须掌握哪些核心能力与资产，才能确保对自身智能资源的控制权？如何在充分利用前沿大模型能力的同时，避免对单一模型提供商形成依赖？开放权重模型（Open-weight Models）与企业控制平面（Enterprise Control Plane）又应在构建更具适应性、安全性和差异化优势的 AI 战略中发挥怎样的作用？

在这场炉边对谈中，Satya Nadella 与斯里达尔·拉马斯瓦米 Sridhar Ramaswamy 将围绕上述问题展开深入探讨，剖析塑造主权 AI 技术栈的关键技术选择与战略考量。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Satya Nadella 与 Sridhar Ramaswamy 讨论企业如何用开放权重模型和企业控制平面捕获工作流轨迹、专家修正，避免专有知识流失。

en.title: Building a Sovereign AI Stack: Open Weights, Frontier Models, and an Enterprise Control Plane
en.reason: Satya Nadella and Sridhar Ramaswamy discuss how enterprises can use open-weight models and an enterprise control plane to capture workflow traces, expert corrections and evaluation results, turning proprietary knowledge into a long-term asset instead of letting AI systems consume it.

sources.title: 安谋科技发布“星辰100e” AIoT 原型平台，AI推理性能最高提升 340 倍
sources.title_zh: 安谋科技发布“星辰100e” AIoT 原型平台，AI推理性能最高提升 340 倍
sources.title_original: 安谋科技发布“星辰100e” AIoT 原型平台，AI推理性能最高提升 340 倍
sources.summary:
更高性能的下一代“星辰”原型平台将于2027年推出。
更高性能的下一代“星辰”原型平台将于2027年推出。
本文字数：2057 字
阅读完需：约 7 分钟
Cortex-M42是面向成本与面积敏感型AIoT端点的新型MCU核心，集成Helium向量加速、ACI自定义指令及AHB紧凑架构，支持从M4/M33平滑演进。安谋科技联合Arm将其本土化为“星辰STAR-MC3”，并纳入全球路线图与Flexible/Total Access授权体系。
· Helium技术显著提升ML/DSP性能，无需增加面积开销
· ACI允许芯片商定制指令，优化特定AIoT负载
· AHB接口设计兼容现有MCU生态，降低升级迁移成本
适合嵌入式芯片架构师、AIoT SoC设计工程师、边缘AI硬件产品负责人阅读
11 月 18 日，安谋科技（中国）有限公司（以下简称“安谋科技”）举办 Arm® Cortex®-M CPU 新品说明会，深度解析 Arm Cortex-M42 CPU，并正式推出基于该产品的“星辰 100e”AIoT 原型平台。
Cortex-M42 处理器面向对成本和面积敏感的智能端点设备打造，基于
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 安谋科技发布基于Cortex-M42与Arm Ethos-U55的星辰100e AIoT原型平台，FPGA已跑通关键字检测、目标识别和语音识别，自动语音识别推理性能提升超340倍。

en.title: New trends in enterprise AI: driving AI Agents into a new phase of large-scale adoption
en.summary:
A new trend in enterprise AI: taking AI Agents to the next stage of scaled adoption

Enterprise AI is evolving from simple productivity tools into AI Agents that can autonomously execute complex workflows and run continuously. But scaling these capabilities still leaves enterprises facing key challenges: a lack of business context, weak governance, rising costs, and a fragmented technology ecosystem.

This session takes a close look at how Snowflake addresses these challenges through a unified platform, helping teams across the business unlock the full value of AI and maximize ROI at scale.
en.reason: Enterprise AI is shifting from task-level efficiency tools to autonomous AI Agents that run complex workflows continuously, and Snowflake's unified platform is presented as the answer to missing business context, weak governance, rising costs and fragmented ecosystems that block scale.

stories.title: AI 时代的数据工程：如何打造 AI 原生团队

sources.title: AI 时代的数据工程：如何打造 AI 原生团队
sources.title_zh: AI 时代的数据工程：如何打造 AI 原生团队
sources.title_original: AI 时代的数据工程：如何打造 AI 原生团队
sources.summary:
AI 时代的数据工程：如何打造 AI 原生团队如今，企业的每一项 AI 战略目标，都离不开数据工程的支撑。AI Agent 正以机器级速度处理企业数据并采取行动，而在作出决策之前，它们不会主动询问某个数据列究竟代表什么含义。

仅仅引入 AI 编程助手，并不足以解决这一问题。因为即使数据管道运行得更快，它本质上仍然只是一条数据管道。

Snowflake 数据工程副总裁 Chris Child 将回顾数据工程领域过去五十年的发展历程，阐释为什么 AI 时代进一步凸显了数据工程的重要性，以及数据工程团队需要具备哪些能力，才能把握这一时代带来的机遇。

en.title: Data Engineering in the AI Era: How to Build an AI-Native Team
en.summary:
Data Engineering in the AI Era: Building an AI-Native Team. Every AI strategic goal a company pursues today depends on data engineering. AI Agents process enterprise data and take action at machine speed, and they don't stop to ask what a given data column actually means before making decisions.

Simply adding an AI coding assistant isn't enough to solve this problem, because even if the data pipeline runs faster, it is still just a data pipeline.

Chris Child, Vice President of Data Engineering at Snowflake, will review the past fifty years of data engineering, explain why the AI era further highlights the importance of data engineering, and outline the capabilities data engineering teams need to seize the opportunities this era presents.
en.reason: Snowflake data engineering VP Chris Child traces 50 years of data engineering to argue that AI agents act on enterprise data at machine speed without asking what a column means, so AI coding assistants alone cannot make a data team AI-native.

sources.title: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
sources.title_zh: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
sources.title_original: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
sources.summary:
重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型AI 正在改变财务部门的角色，使其从传统的财务报告职能，逐步转变为支持实时决策、预测分析和运营转型的核心引擎。

在这场炉边对谈中，Snowflake 首席财务官 Brian Robins 将与 Stripe 首席财务官 Steffan Tomlinson 展开深入交流，共同探讨如何构建 AI 优先的财务与运营组织，加快规划进程、提升生产力、挖掘业务洞察，并支持企业各部门更快速、更有信心地作出决策。

Brian 和 Steffan 将聚焦当前财务领导者最为关注的关键战略问题：

随着 AI 从试点阶段走向生产环境，企业应如何合理安排资本配置的优先顺序，并衡量真实的 ROI？当自动化不断重塑财务部门的工作方式，哪些人类独有的技能将成为企业最重要的资产？企业又该如何充分发挥 AI 前所未有的速度优势，同时确保财务数据所要求的准确性、可审计性与可信度？

en.title: Reshaping the Finance Function: Leading Transformation in the AI Era
en.summary:
Reshaping the finance function: leading transformation in the AI eraAI is changing the role of the finance department, gradually shifting it from traditional financial reporting to a core engine that supports real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, and operational transformation.

In this fireside chat, Snowflake CFO Brian Robins and Stripe CFO Steffan Tomlinson will hold an in-depth discussion on how to build an AI-first finance and operations organization, accelerate planning processes, boost productivity, uncover business insights, and support departments across the company in making decisions faster and with greater confidence.

Brian and Steffan will focus on the key strategic questions that finance leaders care about most today:

As AI moves from the pilot stage to production environments, how should companies prioritize capital allocation and measure real ROI? As automation continues to reshape the way finance departments work, which uniquely human skills will become a company's most important assets? And how can companies fully leverage AI's unprecedented speed while ensuring the accuracy, auditability, and credibility that financial data requires?
Reshaping the finance function: leading transformation in the AI eraAI is changing the role of the finance department, gradually shifting it from traditional financial reporting to a core engine that supports real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, and operational transformation.

In this fireside chat, Snowflake CFO Br
en.reason: Snowflake CFO Brian Robins and Stripe CFO Steffan Tomlinson discuss how AI is shifting finance from reporting to real-time decision-making, covering capital allocation and true ROI as AI moves from pilots to production, the human skills automation cannot replace, and preserving accuracy, auditability and trust in financial data.

items.title: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
items.title_zh: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
items.title_original: 重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型
items.summary:
重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型AI 正在改变财务部门的角色，使其从传统的财务报告职能，逐步转变为支持实时决策、预测分析和运营转型的核心引擎。

在这场炉边对谈中，Snowflake 首席财务官 Brian Robins 将与 Stripe 首席财务官 Steffan Tomlinson 展开深入交流，共同探讨如何构建 AI 优先的财务与运营组织，加快规划进程、提升生产力、挖掘业务洞察，并支持企业各部门更快速、更有信心地作出决策。

Brian 和 Steffan 将聚焦当前财务领导者最为关注的关键战略问题：

随着 AI 从试点阶段走向生产环境，企业应如何合理安排资本配置的优先顺序，并衡量真实的 ROI？当自动化不断重塑财务部门的工作方式，哪些人类独有的技能将成为企业最重要的资产？企业又该如何充分发挥 AI 前所未有的速度优势，同时确保财务数据所要求的准确性、可审计性与可信度？
重塑财务职能：引领 AI 时代的转型AI 正在改变财务部门的角色，使其从传统的财务报告职能，逐步转变为支持实时决策、预测分析和运营转型的核心引擎。

在这场炉边对谈中，Snowflake 首席财务官 Br
items.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇对谈由 Snowflake 首席财务官 Brian Robins 与 Stripe 首席财务官 Steffan Tomlinson 展开，聚焦 AI 从试点到生产后的资本配置与真实 ROI、自动化下人类独有技能，以及财务数据可信度。

stories.title: 当你的下一位客户是 AI Agent：企业营销与销售的 AI 发展前景

sources.title: 当你的下一位客户是 AI Agent：企业营销与销售的 AI 发展前景
sources.title_zh: 当你的下一位客户是 AI Agent：企业营销与销售的 AI 发展前景
sources.title_original: 当你的下一位客户是 AI Agent：企业营销与销售的 AI 发展前景
sources.summary:
当你的下一位客户是 AI Agent：企业营销与销售的 AI 发展前景购买行为正在进入一个全新时代。AI Agent 开始影响消费者发现、评估、比较和选择产品的方式。在消费者访问网站或与销售人员交流之前，Agent 就已经阅读品牌发布的内容、汇总不同选项，并帮助消费者缩小选择范围。

与此同时，营销和销售组织也在利用 AI 推动自身转型，将过去由一系列营销活动和销售策略组成的工作模式，升级为能够持续运行的增长体系。这一体系能够深入理解客户需求、优先识别高价值商机，并实时加速营收增长。

这两场变革正在同步发生，并深刻改变着企业创造市场需求和赢得客户的方式。

当品牌信息的第一位“读者”变成机器，品牌建设、内容营销和需求开发将发生怎样的变化？企业如何确保自身能够被 AI 发现，并在 AI 生成的推荐结果中赢得信任？当买卖双方都开始使用 AI Agent，客户关系又将如何演变？

哪些营销和销售工作流应该率先重新设计？相关岗位与技能又该如何随之调整？企业领导者应如何判断，AI 究竟带来了真正的业务成效，还是仅仅让业务活动变得更加频繁？

在这场炉边对谈中，OpenAI 首席营销官 Coli
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 的 Colin Fleming 与 Snowflake 的 Denise Persson 炉边对谈：当 AI Agent 在消费者访问网站前已阅读品牌内容、汇总选项并缩小范围，企业营销与销售如何确保被 AI 发现并赢得信任。

en.title: When Your Next Customer Is an AI Agent: The AI Outlook for Enterprise Marketing and Sales
en.summary:
When your next customer is an AI Agent: the AI outlook for enterprise marketing and sales

Purchasing behavior is entering a new era. AI Agents are beginning to shape how consumers discover, evaluate, compare and choose products. Before a consumer visits a website or talks to a salesperson, an Agent has already read the content brands publish, summarized the options and helped narrow the field.

At the same time, marketing and sales organizations are using AI to transform themselves, upgrading a model built around a series of campaigns and sales tactics into a growth system that runs continuously—one that understands customer needs deeply, prioritizes high-value opportunities and accelerates revenue in real time.

These two shifts are happening in parallel and are fundamentally changing how enterprises create market demand and win customers.

When the first "reader" of brand messaging is a machine, how will brand building, content marketing and demand generation change? How can companies ensure they are discoverable by AI and earn trust in AI-generated recommendations? And as both buyers and sellers begin using AI Agents, how will customer relationships evolve?

Which marketing and sales workflows should be redesigned first, and how should roles and skills adjust accordingly? How should business leaders judge whether AI is delivering real business results or simply making activity more frequent?

In this fireside chat, OpenAI Chief Marketing Officer Coli
en.reason: OpenAI CMO Colin Fleming and Snowflake’s Denise Persson examine how AI agents read brand content, aggregate options and narrow choices before consumers visit a site or talk to sales, forcing marketing and sales to earn AI discoverability and trust.

en.title: Learning Agent now is like getting into Douyin in 2018. If you had started learning self-media in 2020, you would surely have built up solid results by now; the same goes for starting to learn AI Agent development now. Back then, no one realized that self-media meant a disruption to content distribution: gaining hundreds or thousands of followers was no longer a privilege reserved for celebrities, and promoting a product no longer necessarily meant working with traditional media.

sources.summary: Agent 能不能自己积累经验、改进技能，还越用越省钱？本期精选的10篇AI 论文从让 AI 记住每次修改的得失、自动盯训练，到精简 Skill、审核高风险更新，集中探讨了“如何让智能体持续进步”。做 Agent 开发或关注 AI 研究的朋友，可以重点看看其中的实践思路。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Cloud AI、Google DeepMind 和宾夕法尼亚州立大学提出带记忆的 SIM 优化器，记录改动理由与实测结果，解决框架从 Opus 迁到 Gemini 后起始得分 68.41 低于初始 73.89 的退化，十次编程实验九次提升，平均增 2.36 分（p=0.003）。

en.title: Nov 16–22 | This Week’s Top AI Papers
en.summary: Can agents accumulate experience on their own, improve their skills, and get cheaper to run the more they're used? This edition's 10 selected AI papers—spanning everything from letting AI remember the gains and losses of each edit and automatically monitoring training, to streamlining Skills and reviewing high-risk updates—focus on "how to make agents keep improving." Anyone building Agents or following AI research should take a close look at the practical ideas inside.
en.reason: Google DeepMind, Google Cloud AI and Penn State's SIM optimizer uses memory to fix a 68.41-vs-73.89 drop after Opus-to-Gemini migration and improve 9 of 10 coding experiments by 2.36 points (p=0.003), one of 10 papers on agents learning from experience.

en.title: The mainstream approach to AI knowledge bases is RAG — so how do you build RAG?
en.reason: RAG knowledge bases chunk documents into 300–800 characters with 10%–20% overlap, index them by vector and keyword for retrieval, then have the model answer with sources cited, starting with 50–200 core documents on an existing platform.
